---
title: "Stress DSA"
guide-section: "DSA & analysis"
---

Excel analogues: **Input 6** standard stress parameters, **B** (external) and
**B1** (public) shock sheets, residual financing from **Input 7**, and Output
**2-x / 3-x** stressed ratio paths.

Package: `lic_dsf.stress`. Baseline ratios stay in `lic_dsf.dsa`; this layer
shocks Macro, fills residual financing, and rebuilds Output-shaped panels.

## What you get

| Piece | Role |
|-------|------|
| `load_input6_standard` | Input 6 shock sizes / rules |
| `load_input7_residual_params` | Input 7 ResFin terms (`lic_dsf.pv`) |
| `run_standard_external_stress` | Suite of external B-tests |
| `run_a1_historical_external` | A1: key variables at 10-year historical averages |
| `run_b1_gdp_external` / `run_b3_exports_external` / … | Named external scenarios |
| `run_b1_gdp_public` | Public B1 GDP with three-way ResFin |
| `StressExternalBook` / `StressPublicBook` | Stressed ratio engines |
| `stress_external_panel` / `stress_public_panel` | Output 2/3-shaped frames |

## Load and compute

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.pv import (
    ExternalDebtBook,
    MacroDebtBook,
    PVPortfolio,
    load_external_debt_inputs,
    load_input7_residual_params,
    load_instruments_from_workbook,
    load_lc_nr_instruments_from_workbook,
    load_macro_debt_inputs,
)
from lic_dsf.stress import (
    load_input6_standard,
    run_b1_gdp_external,
    run_b1_gdp_public,
    run_standard_external_stress,
    stress_external_panel,
    stress_public_panel,
)

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
ext = ExternalDebtBook(
    portfolio=PVPortfolio(
        instruments=tuple(
            load_instruments_from_workbook(workbook, include_zero_disbursement=True)
        )
        + tuple(
            load_lc_nr_instruments_from_workbook(
                workbook, include_zero_disbursement=True
            )
        )
    ),
    inputs=load_external_debt_inputs(workbook),
)
macro = MacroDebtBook(inputs=load_macro_debt_inputs(workbook), external=ext)
input6 = load_input6_standard(workbook)
residual = load_input7_residual_params(workbook)

# One external scenario
b1_ext = run_b1_gdp_external(macro, ext, input6, residual)
stress_external_panel(b1_ext)

# Full external suite (dict of scenario id → book)
suite = run_standard_external_stress(macro, ext, input6, residual)

# Public B1 GDP (ext MLT / dom MLT / ST ResFin split)
b1_pub = run_b1_gdp_public(macro, ext, input6, residual)
stress_public_panel(b1_pub)
```

## Excel cues

| Concept | Where in template |
|---------|-------------------|
| Shock magnitudes | Input 6 |
| External vs public ResFin terms | Input 7 (external DSA vs public J-column shares) |
| External stressed ratios | B sheets → Output 2-1 / 3-1 |
| Public stressed ratios | B1 → Output 2-2 / 3-2 |

External DSA residual fill is typically 100% external PPG MLT; public fill
keeps the three-way shares from Input 7.

## Caveats

Public GFN (B1 R90) is the fiscal + debt-service identity; ResFin is
``R90 − baseline GFN``, solved with a short fixed-point loop.
